title: Deploy from GitHub Actions with an OIDC role instead of manual cdk deploy
description: Today the stack is deployed by hand with the legacy SSO profile. Add an IAM OIDC provider/role for this repo and a deploy workflow (cdk diff on PRs, deploy after a release), modeled on Chatticus's github-deploy-stack. Also set branch protection on develop and main requiring specs, commitlint, typecheck.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Handoff update (2026-10-10): verified that Actions currently run CI and Semantic Release only; production remains manual `AWS_PROFILE=legacy npx cdk deploy`. The account already has the GitHub Actions OIDC provider and CDK bootstrap v32, but no repository-scoped deploy role was identified yet. New coordination epic SIE-a87ccc and workflow task SIE-1bb857 record the requested goal. Do not create or alter IAM/OIDC grants until the exact role trust and least-privilege resource policy have explicit action-time approval.
